Lichtlaerm Audio browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive distortion browse by enclosure pedal Lichtlaerm Audio Thorn - Amenra Signature Distortion Published on August 27, 2025 Lichtlaerm Audio distortion pedal Information The Thorn is a signature distortion pedal developed in collaboration with Lennart Bossu of Amenra, designed to capture and modernize the singular voice that has defined his sound across Amenra, Oathbreaker, Predatory Void, and Living Gate. The pedal is rooted in the sonic character of Bossu's original Providence Stampede SDT-1, a rare unit that became central to his tone but carried practical limitations such as its large enclosure, fixed boost, and wall-voltage power. Through extensive reverse-engineering, the Thorn recreates the raw, organic roar of that exact unit while introducing critical refinements for modern use. It features three selectable modes: SDT-1 for faithful replication of the original's voice, SDT-2 for the more compressed and saturated tones used in Living Gate, and laerm, a proprietary mode offering a louder, more open, and direct response. The pedal includes an adjustable, footswitchable boost and a 1 kHz mid control for precise presence shaping. A bypassable 3-band active EQ is also provided, with the option to lift the tone stack entirely from the circuit for a direct guitar-to-amp connection. Designed with high headroom via an internal charge pump, the Thorn ensures a transparent, articulate, and massive sound that functions both as an homage to the Providence Stampede lineage and as a distinct, standalone distortion voice. Controls Volume Gain 3-band active EQ (Bass, Mid with 1 kHz control, Treble) EQ bypass switch Mode selector: SDT-1, SDT-2, laerm Boost level Footswitchable boost Bypass footswitch with Smart Relay technology Specifications Effect type: Distortion Signature model: Lennart Bossu (Amenra) Power supply: 9V DC, center-negative High headroom design with internal charge pump Highlights Developed in collaboration with Lennart Bossu of Amenra Inspired by the Providence Stampede SDT-1 Three modes: SDT-1, SDT-2, and proprietary laerm Bypassable 3-band active EQ with EQ lift option Adjustable, footswitchable boost Smart Relay bypass switching Direct, transparent, and organic distortion voice Video Date ▼▲ Maker ▼▲ Video

We reverse-engineered Lennart’s Providence Stampede SDT-1 and reimagined it with critical evolutions including a 1 kHz mid control and an adjustable footswitchable boost. SDT-1 mode keeps the original’s soul; SDT-2 adds more compression/saturation; laerm is a proprietary voicing that’s more open and louder. A bypassable 3-band active EQ is included, with an EQ-lift option to remove the tone stack for a direct guitar→amp connection. Features include Lichtlaerm Audio Smart Relay bypass, footswitchable boost, and a high-headroom design with an internal charge pump. MG ID: 55271 Amenra Signature Distortion LICHTLAERM AUDIO x AMENRA "Thorn" Nail my torn flesh to the cross. Thrust a spear deep in my side. I carried my cross long enough. I wear my love like a crown of thorns The Thorn is a collaboration between Lichtlaerm Audio and post-metal powerhouse Amenra - an attempt to distill the unmistakable voice of Lennart Bossu into a form that can live on any stage, in any rig, anywhere in the world. A bit of history: for years, Lennart’s sound has been defined by an old and rare Providence Stampede SDT-1 - discovered through recordings from Kurt Ballou’s God City Studios (famed for its use on early Converge records and beyond). That one battered unit became his weapon of choice across Oathbreaker, Amenra, Predatory Void and Living Gate, shaping not only his voice but an entire Belgian scene orbiting around Amenra and its members. The original SDT-1 has a singular, organic roar - but also some inconvenient baggage: a massive enclosure, direct wall-voltage power, a fixed boost, and a few other quirks. Later Providence revisions solved some of those problems, but at the expense of its unique sonic fingerprint. Lichtlaerm Audio set out to reverse-engineer Lennart’s exact unit and reimagine it for the modern stage. The result: a faithful recreation with a few critical evolutions. They added a 1 kHz mid control for surgical presence-shaping. They made the footswitchable boost adjustable. They kept the soul of his exact unit in the SDT-1 mode, but added an SDT-2 mode for the more compressed, saturated tones Lennart leans on in Living Gate. And, true to their nature, they couldn’t resist adding a third, proprietary voicing - laerm - more open, louder, and more direct than any Stampede ever was. They kept the EQ bypass that was present on the original unit but got lost in later revisions: lifting the tone stack completely from the circuit for an even more immediate connection between guitar and amp. In Lennart’s own setup, the Thorn feeds straight into an Ampeg V4 with EQ bypassed, turning it into an extension of the amp’s own voice rather than an overlay. With the Thorn, you hold not only the sound of Amenra, Oathbreaker and countless others but a distortion that stands on its own: direct, transparent, and articulate, yet massive and organic. It’s a voice you won’t find anywhere else.
